description: Project-wide settings, backdrop and imported media edits.

actions.description: Set what fills the frame where there is no picture, including behind a speaker whose background is removed (a background swap): a flat colour, or a generated preset. Send color or preset.
Set project aspect ratio, visual filter/strength, video-track visibility or mute. Only supplied fields change. Applies the same project-wide settings as the manual controls.

Append imported media to the main track, remove media and its timeline instances (original files kept), or reset its main-track cuts to the full source. Uses media IDs from context. Removing/resetting locked clips is rejected.

color.description: Hex colour: #RGB, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA. Setting a colour clears any preset.

preset.description: A generated dark surface instead of a flat colour; none goes back to the colour.

presetColors.description: Colours for the preset as #RRGGBB, background first, in the same slot order as editor.overlays.setProperties backdropColors. An empty array goes back to the preset's own colours.

sourceStart.description: With append, the recording second the new clip starts at, as the trim handles on a media row choose. Leave it out to start at the top of the file. Ignored for pictures.

sourceEnd.description: With append, the recording second the new clip ends at. Leave it out to run to the end of the file. Ignored for pictures.
